label: <DEL> step of the longest (L=9) sequences, content-gated
explanation: Fires only at the delimiter step (100% of mass on in_tok=<DEL>, recall_idx=0) and only for long sequences: L=9 holds 88% of mass (t=9) and L=8 the rest (t=8); it never fires in the original or copy phases or for L<=7. Within L=9 delimiter steps only about 2% fire, so precision is low: whether it crosses threshold depends on sequence content in a diffuse way. Activity is enriched (but far from determined) when the last original token is e, j or 0 (prev_tok=e alone gives ~12% precision), and when the sequence has more digits (rate rises with n_digits); many top examples have a digit 2 or 3 among the first few tokens. None of these content cues gave a clean rule (best content-refined F1 ~0.16). Magnitude is small (max 0.026) and is higher for L=9 than L=8; no content variable cleanly modulated magnitude.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig2=2 (+3.52), prev_tok=e (+2.90), orig2=k (+2.59), L=9 & t=9 (+2.42), prev_tok=0 (+2.20), prev_tok=j (+2.19). Lower it: in_first=0 (-3.86), orig7=- (-3.67), in_count=1 (-1.91), prev2_tok=k (-1.90).
